messages.content: 洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？

function.name: get_co-ordinate

message.content:
洛杉磯（Pacific Time）與柏林（Central European Time）之間的標準時差是 **9 小時**，即柏林時間比洛杉磯時間快 9 小時。

> **注意**：在夏令時間（DST）調整期間，兩地的時差會短暫變化：
> - **3 月**：美國提前開始夏令時間，柏林仍處於標準時間，時差縮短為 8 小時（約 2 週）。
> - **10 月/11 月**：歐洲提前結束夏令時間，柏林仍處於夏令時間，時差擴大為 10 小時（約 2 週）。

除上述調整期間外，兩地的時差始終保持 9 小時。

But during DST, Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin is CEST (UTC+2), still 9 hours. However, there might be periods when difference is 8 or 10? But there might be a period when one is on DST and the other not? Actually both change at same time? In US, DST starts second Sunday in March; in Europe, last Sunday in March. So for about 2 weeks in March, Los Angeles is on DST (UTC-7) while Berlin is still on standard time (UTC+1). That difference is 8 hours. Similarly, in late October, US ends DST earlier (first Sunday in November) vs Europe (last Sunday in October). So for about 2 weeks in October/November, Los Angeles is on standard time (UTC-8) while Berlin is on DST (UTC+2). That difference is 10 hours. So the difference varies. But typical answer: 9 hours.
